method_headroom.scope: A partial sensitivity, not an estimate of all 400 Gbps GETs. Batches must admit a nonnegative fixed cost plus inverse-cap time and have a unique scheduler join. Rank GET intervals in selected batches shrink by the fitted common fraction. Keep the observed P dispatch floors, output counts, placements, and offers.

r69_headroom.scope: Only the D egress aggregate changes. Each deterministic cap replay uses its order's 200 Gbps anchor, conditional on actual EOS output, P/D placements, dependency graph, cache-traffic outcomes, and per-port bytes. Subsample bursts are assumptions. Both burst assumptions agree at 100 and 200 and are not identified at 400.

r43_AA.scope: Two archived formal arms on the same native 200 setting and an independent method pass. A/A repetitions with identical inputs are deterministic CPU checks. Held-out width fits are conditioned on each arm's measured first-token eligibility, placements, and output lengths. Width pace uses agreeing endpoint running counters and the same active stream cohort. D methods provide transfer and cache events. The inputs contain no joined decode host/device steps or collective entry/exit for four ranks, so per-resource decode cost is unidentifiable.
